# Domingo Restaurant

> Restaurant in San Antonio, Texas. Churro pancakes, elote street corn and short rib quesadilla, near the San Antonio River.

- Phone: (210) 404-7516
- Address: 123 N St Mary's St, San Antonio, TX 78205
- Areas: San Antonio, Converse, Schertz, Boerne, New Braunfels
- Offers: Churro pancakes; Tacos; Brunch and breakfast
- Rating: 4.7 from 10621 Google reviews
